name: filter-bar
title: Filter bar
description: One facet per field, always in the same place, each opening its own choices (checkboxes, presets, a date range), and the result count live as they change.

FilterBarRoot.description: The bar on its own: the parts go inside. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

props.name: fields
props.description: What can be filtered: one facet each, in this order.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every change: a pick, a preset, a range, a clear.

props.name: resultCount
props.description: How many rows the filters let through, shown live ("14 results"). Leave it out to hide the count.

props.name: resultLabel
props.description: The count's words, "14 deals": `number` is the rolling number, `count` picks the plural. Defaults to the `filterResults` label.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target of the menus, the date surface and the tooltip. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: today
props.description: Today, for the calendar and for which dates show their year. Defaults to now.

FilterBarFacet.description: One field's facet: idle, its label and a chevron; set, its value and a ×. The surface it opens fits the field's type (checkboxes, presets, presets and a calendar). Other props, `ref` included, go to its outer `span`.

props.name: field
props.description: The field's `key`. A key the bar's `fields` don't have renders nothing.

FilterBarClear.description: Clears every filter, then focuses the first facet. An icon button with a tooltip, so the count keeps its row; nothing while no filter applies. Other props, `ref` included, go to the Button.

FilterBarCount.description: "14 results" at the end of the row, its digits rolling as the count changes and read out once it does. Nothing without `resultCount`. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `span`.

FilterBar.description: The bar from props: a facet per field in order, then Clear, then the count at the end of the row. Other props, `ref` included, go to the bar's `div`.
